name: @nanoforge/inspectors
description: The running game from the inside: tick times and systems, network packets, and the ECS world.

tip.text: While the game plays: tick time, and the time per library and per system. Click the chart to freeze it.
While the game plays: the packets it sends and receives, with their size and content.
While the game plays: every entity with its components, live. Search with Position or Position.x > 100.

settings.title: Tick time budget (ms)
settings.description: The Profiler draws this line and marks the windows whose slowest tick went over it. 16.7 ms is 60 ticks per second.
